title: moderation.sanctions_export
description: Cursor-paged snapshot of every sanctioned user — the source_of_truth half of the moderation.user_sanctions Projection, read by rebuild() and drift_check(). Response: {"rows": [{"subject_user_id", "allowed", "sanctions", "seq"}], "cursor": string|null, "total": integer|null}. The shape is NOT {items, cursor}: stapel_core.comm.projections._iter_snapshot reads resp["rows"], and an items-shaped answer would rebuild the table to empty without a single error (moderation spec §22.1). `seq` is unix MILLISECONDS, the same clock as an Event timestamp.

cursor.description: Continuation token from the previous page. Null/absent starts at the beginning.

limit.description: Rows per page; absent means EXPORT_PAGE_SIZE, values above 2000 are clamped.
